_doc: Gate calibration registry (WI-01). verdict: approved | rejected | superseded | candidate. 'approved' images MUST pass every blocking gate (scripts/backtest-gates.mjs exits 1 otherwise); 'rejected' images should be caught by at least one blocking gate (exit 2 if they pass all). 'superseded' and 'candidate' are informational only. Append new approved entries with giga-run export --approve <runId>. | USER NOTE 2026-10-29: approved entries are 'the best results we could have, not perfect things' -> they are FLOORS for blocking gates (calibrated hard values keep a small margin below them); stricter 'goal' values stay as warnings the agent is pushed toward. Never loosen a gate below what a REJECTED entry needs to fail.
